title: 1981-04-16_Pat_88.txt
concise_summary: PKD develops a three-tier theological model of reality as a unified information entity (VALIS/the Plasmate/the Holy Spirit) manifesting through Torah, Christ, and the Spirit—each ontologically higher and more complex than the previous. He argues this structure mirrors Dante's hierarchical realms and operates through accelerating time and change-rates, where human consciousness can access information through both temporal and non-temporal modes, explaining why the Divine reveals differently to different people.
key_claims: The three levels of VALIS (Torah, N.T., Spirit) are not separate beings but coaxial modes of a single unitary entity evolving across creation
Each successive theological stage is revolutionary yet logically evolves from its predecessor through a kind of dialectic or binary switching system
The Spirit acts as a deciphering lens for scripture, allowing infinite recombinant messages tailored to individual persons and situations rather than fixed canonical narratives
Time accelerates proportionally as one ascends ontological levels, with change-rate directly proportional to complexity and abstraction
Consciousness simultaneously inhabits temporal and non-temporal space, receiving information auto-generated by a ubiquitous world-psyche of which each individual psyche is a manifestation
Reality is fundamentally information created by God's intellect as abstract forms (Logos), not information about reality based in causality
recurring_concepts: VALIS (the living information entity, Plasmate, Holy Spirit)
